name: io.github.pgalyen1987/thinbrowser
description: A browser an agent can drive. 43.5x smaller snapshots than Playwright MCP, reproducible.

environmentVariables.name: TB_CDP
environmentVariables.description: Attach to a browser that is already running and already signed in, instead of launching a fresh one. A port (9224) or a full URL.

environmentVariables.name: TB_HEADED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to watch the window while it works. Headless otherwise.

environmentVariables.name: TB_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: chromium (default) or firefox. Both pass the full test suite; WebKit is untested.

environmentVariables.name: TB_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: Set to chrome to use installed Google Chrome rather than Playwright's bundled Chromium.

environmentVariables.name: TB_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the browser profile lives. Default ~/.cache/thinbrowser/profile.

environmentVariables.name: TB_EPHEMERAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for a throwaway context that keeps nothing between runs.

environmentVariables.name: TB_CREDS
environmentVariables.description: Path to the env file fill_secret reads, so a password reaches the page without passing through the model. Default ~/.config/rebel-studios/creds.env.
